note: A UNIT CROSSING NEEDS A GUARD YOU HAVE WATCHED FAIL. The Ell moved the history bake from years to days at the ledger boundary, creating 16 crossing sites. Each was mutated one at a time against the FULL hornvale-worldgen + hornvale-almanac + hornvale suite (881 tests, ~170s a run). FIVE OF SIXTEEN had no guard at all, and the review that found the class named an example that was in fact guarded -- one crate up, by cli/tests/history_render.rs, which the review missed by scoping its mutation to hornvale-almanac. So: scope a mutation to the GATE, not to the crate you are reading. The worst of the five was descent::founded_year, whose blast radius is a COMMITTED CENSUS VALUE that no gate run rebuilds; its two plausible existing guards cannot catch it by construction, one because it counts zero-gap edges (zero is zero in any unit) and the other because it keys a map on the year form, invariant under any injective rescaling. Both tests are correct, green, and about something else. Three further crossings are deliberately unconverted because they are ordering-only and monotone-invariant -- write that reason at the site or the next sweep re-derives it.
